subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat message long-press ship the full Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply action set now, or should the first implementation be limited to copy and selection?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the proposed action set changes message UX and Reply semantics beyond a narrow clipboard affordance, and the linked implementation candidate is not merge-ready.

options.title: Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Land a focused clipboard/selection sheet now and leave Share and Reply for a separate approved UX pass.

options.title: Full action sheet
options.body: Adopt the full action set only after defining how Reply quotes reach the composer/model context and proving link/scroll behavior.

options.title: Decline core change
options.body: Keep Android message reuse limited to code blocks and close the issue if maintainers decide the extra chat action surface is not wanted.

recommendation.title: Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Land a focused clipboard/selection sheet now and leave Share and Reply for a separate approved UX pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Android chat history and the latest current-main changes point to steipete as the strongest available routing owner for this UX/product choice.
